steps.text: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
You had two hours to tell me
I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
I was right about one person
After accusing all seven of them
Thorough detective work
And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
I noticed. I let you have it
That's what I'm choosing to believe
Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
You brought most of it with you
I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
You were taking too much of the cushion
Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
And your spoon
Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
The arcade?
Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
He doesn't know half of it
He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
I'm allowing him exactly one
Generous
I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
Don't let him choose every game
He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
Of course he has
I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
You won't need it
INSIDE THE ARCADE
You came prepared
For what?
Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
I brought you something, actually
A consolation prize already?
A pastry. I can still eat it myself
No, I'll accept the apology in advance
You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
Thank you. That was nice of you
There. See how little effort that took?
Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
Only the annoying ones
That's most of my material
You'll have to improvise
AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
That first point didn't count
The machine disagrees
You hit it before I was ready
You were explaining how easy this was going to be
I was being welcoming
You said you'd go easy on me
And clearly that was a mistake
So you admit I won?
I admit there's room for a second game
No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
{{name:player}} put you up to this
He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
I'm going to have a word with him
About knowing you too well?
About coaching the opposition
I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
You did. That last shot was good
Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
Don't push it
I might need a moment to appreciate it
I'll give you five seconds
You really do count everything
Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
At least give me a second to look less defeated
Too late. That's the face I want
A MOMENT LATER
He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
I recognize that face
He's blaming you for warning me
Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
I'll spare him that one for now 😌
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
What next, then?
The photo booth is tempting 😊
To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
At least one? That's optimistic
Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
That's not how photo booths work
Too late. The countdown has started

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.

steps.text: You pulled a face in the first one
And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
That isn't how winning works
Then explain the last picture
You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
You're impossible 😌
Still choosing pinball after this?
Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
There's literally a score on that one too
You can keep yours to yourself
LATER, OUTSIDE
I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
My ears are still inside playing the racing game
Your dignity is in there somewhere too
I had a good time
Even though I won?
Even though you're never going to let that go
I had a good time too
Shall I walk with you for a bit?
Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
That sounds sensible
That was almost an invitation
Almost?
Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
I'd like that
And no asking where I keep a second controller
Not even going to mention it
I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
Already missing the film commentary?
I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
Your new contact?
Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
A shame there isn't a documentary
Don't encourage me
BACK AT HOME
Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
That's not much progress
I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
Talk later, then
Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
LATER THAT EVENING
I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
You've been exchanging photos?
Yes. This is the smile he asked for
And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
That's an answer you would like
It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
Your photo is lovely, by the way
I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
